notes: 503A compounding pharmacy warning letter: firm compounded drug products intended to be sterile under insanitary conditions (ISO 5 airflow/smoke-study deficiencies, dirty surfaces) and released subpotent and sterility-test-failing product, leading to a voluntary recall. Classified letter_type as 'compounding' rather than 'cgmp_sterile' because the legal analysis is framed entirely around the 503A exemption and 501(a)(2)(A) insanitary-conditions adulteration, not a CGMP (21 CFR 211) citation; judgment call given the letter also reads like a sterile-manufacturing letter in substance.
